title: Why Tech Layoffs Aren't Going Away
full_monologue: **Tech layoffs aren’t just about money.** They’re about misaligned priorities. Companies are chasing AI hype and short-term gains, not long-term value. When innovation outpaces execution, cuts follow. Then there’s the global economy—uncertainty makes hiring risky. And let’s be real: not every startup can scale. So when the bubble pops, the real reason becomes clear: survival, not growth, is the goal. What do you think is the biggest driver of layoffs in tech? Comment below.
